fusions.name: Bodkin Point
fusions.desc: Looses a hardened point at the first enemy in line for 28 damage, ignoring armour. The target is left [Sundered] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Misericorde
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health: a thrust that deals 22 damage and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing in Harness
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage, holds for 6 seconds and raises your armour by 8% while it holds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Gap in the Plates
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
